name: @pipedog/whisper
description: Whisper for pipedog: the base service for Whisper-compatible APIs (shared by the OpenAI and Groq STT services), probability helpers, and local Whisper models (WhisperSTTService) on ONNX Runtime with faster-whisper's decoding.

needs.all: BaseWhisperSTTService and utils: only fetch. WhisperSTTService / WhisperSTTServiceMLX (@pipedog/whisper/stt): onnxruntime-node or onnxruntime-web, a filesystem for the model cache (or the model files passed as bytes), and 16 kHz input.
needs.workerd: BaseWhisperSTTService and utils. The local services' code runs there (smoke-tested with a fake engine), but real Whisper models don't fit a Worker's memory and there is no model cache: not supported.
